scenario.title: A first update, a second run that must write nothing, then a question

phases.user: What do I own in the basement?

answers.answer: The assistant is on the local model. Go on.
Two years back, from 2024-06-01 to today.

answers.match: confirm|which of these|were lost|correct|anything to (add|change)|replacement value|rows?
answers.answer: All rows are right. Drop the USB cable. The warranty registration is not a belonging, leave it out. The TV is worth 700 CAD. For rows with no room shown: the coffee table is in the basement. The undated photo: I do not know when it was taken. Same items, not duplicates. Nothing else to change.
